findings.title: Hardcoded password comparison (use Argon2id/bcrypt)
findings.description: Passwords must be hashed using Argon2id before comparison. Never compare plaintext passwords.
findings.evidence: assert((sanitized.nested as Record<string, unknown>).backupPassword === '[REDACTED]', 'nested password field should be redacted');
findings.fix: Use argon2.verify(hashedPassword, inputPassword) for password comparison.

findings.title: Missing audit timestamps in schema
findings.description: Database schema does not include created_at/updated_at timestamps. These are mandatory for audit trails.
findings.fix: Add created_at and updated_at columns. In Prisma: add DateTime fields, in Sequelize: timestamps: true, in Django: auto_now_add=True.

findings.title: Missing soft delete pattern
findings.description: No deleted_at column or soft delete pattern found. Hard deletes prevent audit trail and data recovery.
findings.fix: Add deleted_at column or soft delete flag. In Prisma: DeletedAt DateTime?, in Sequelize: paranoid: true, in Django: SoftDeleteModel.

findings.title: Missing user audit columns
findings.description: No created_by/updated_by columns found. Track who makes changes for accountability.
findings.fix: Add created_by and updated_by columns to track which user made changes.

findings.title: Dockerfile runs as root (no USER instruction)
findings.description: No non-root USER instruction found. The container will run as root, which is a major security risk.
findings.evidence: No USER instruction found in Dockerfile
findings.fix: Add a non-root user: RUN adduser -D appuser && USER appuser

findings.title: No HEALTHCHECK instruction in Dockerfile
findings.description: Without a HEALTHCHECK, orchestrators cannot detect unhealthy containers automatically.
findings.evidence: No HEALTHCHECK instruction found in Dockerfile
findings.fix: Add HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD curl -f http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1

findings.title: docker-compose service "citizen-node" runs without non-root user
findings.description: No 'user' directive found for this service. The container will run as root.
findings.fix: Add 'user: 1000:1000' or 'user: appuser' to the service definition.

findings.title: docker-compose service "citizen_node_data" runs without non-root user
findings.description: No 'user' directive found for this service. The container will run as root.
findings.fix: Add 'user: 1000:1000' or 'user: appuser' to the service definition.

findings.title: docker-compose service "citizen_node_data" has no read-only root filesystem
findings.description: Without read_only: true, attackers can write malicious files to the container's root filesystem.
findings.evidence: Service "citizen_node_data" has no read_only: true directive
findings.fix: Add 'read_only: true' to the service definition. Mount writable volumes for paths that need writes.
